summary.en: A front from the anchor turns halftone dots into square blocks, which re-sort inside out into the next field.
summary.zh: 从锚点跑出的波前把网点变成方块，方块再由内向外重排成下一个场。

fits: A picture becoming data: audio to text, a signal to a log, an image to tokens.
notFor: Films without a halftone field; any cut that should feel soft.

intent.en: A signal becomes data before the viewer's eyes: the same picture is reprinted as blocks and re-sorted into the next one.
intent.zh: 信号在观众眼前变成数据：同一张画面被重印成方块，再重排成下一张。

content.en: Two field kinds round the anchor (from, to) on paper or ink.
content.zh: 锚点周围的两种场（起、止），纸底或墨底。

fits.zh: 画面变成数据：声音到文字、信号到日志、图像到词元。

notFor.zh: 没有网点场的片；该柔和的切换。

en: Blocks that agree must not move; animating every block turns the re-sort into noise.
zh: 前后一致的方块不能动；每块都动，重排就成了噪点。

overlaps.note: field-morph changes a field’s parameters behind a front with the dots kept; dot-quantize reprints the field as binary blocks and re-sorts them

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
